# PROPMYGANDA (PMG)

> Independent music, content, and distribution company based in Brooklyn, NY. 100% independent — distribution, content, and culture.

PMG delivers music to all major DSPs, builds content campaigns around releases, runs the Nonstop NY events series, and publishes editorial on independent music and culture.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of PMG, the manifesto, and pillars.
- [Records / Artists](/artists): The PMG roster of independent artists.
- [Distribution](/distribution): Digital distribution, marketing, sync, and catalog services. Apply here.
- [Events](/events): Nonstop NY upcoming and past shows.
- [Publication](/publication): Editorial on business, artists, culture, milestones, industry.
- [Store](/store): Official PMG and artist merchandise.
- [Propworld](/propworld): Interactive 3D world.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the PMG team in Brooklyn, NY.
